scope: Unchanged optimized guest, identical observers and machine; two warmups then eight samples per ordinary case and three exposure bursts.

pin.scope: GEM VDI development: FX 1.26 at D600, private 512 KiB VRAM, inactive at cold boot. Detection only is tested by G0.

peripherals.name: happy-none
peripherals.firmware: built-in high-level model; quiet command only

observer.mode: same binary, EXEC816_LATENCY_TRACE and EXEC816_MASK_TRACE environment gates; replay with both unset

keyboard_input.mode: POKEY matrix scan; PushRawKey/ReleaseRawKey immediate=false; modifier matrix transitions
keyboard_input.initialization: KEY ALL up enables scan mode before modifier changes

mouse_input.mapping: unmodified built-in preset; all other input maps disabled in isolated test profile
mouse_input.host_path: ATInputManager::OnMouseMove(0, dx, dy); OnButtonChanged(0, MouseLMB, state)
mouse_input.sensitivity: default preset: 16 integer host units per electrical transition; no mapping acceleration
mouse_input.capture: headless scheduled relative motion; GUI uses normal host mouse capture
mouse_input.observer: EXEC816_MOUSE_TRACE=1 logs MOUSE_HOST and passive MOUSE_PHASE in base scheduler cycles; unset for replay
mouse_input.controller_timing: Unmodified slow (scanline) scheduler: each phase delay clamps 0x1000000/remaining fixed-point distance to 1..256 scanlines. The passive observer timestamps output on the base CPU scheduler.

presenter_control_review.explanation: Small-object presenter median rises 9.3% as work overlaps different samples (0 to 188 ms). Total presenter CPU across eight measured samples changes only +0.016%; drawing counts and frames match. Presenter drawing/polling code is unchanged; all measured END calls are local. Other caller/elapsed controls remain below 5% regression.

validation.heap_scope: Native fixture checks exact AvailMem equality; matched image restores bank ownership after shutdown.

limits: Development tier only; no hosted-system/hardware qualification or demo refresh.

All measured END calls are local. BEGIN has occasional RPC fallback, whose ranges are recorded separately; real-client lock/cache fixtures also cover mixed local/RPC behavior. No RPC speedup is claimed.
Inclusive helper costs overlap; small cohorts do not establish tail latency.
Exposure delivery and repair area must be compared separately; its timing is not a per-rectangle speedup.
